answer: PoA propagates trust through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, making influence decay across weak regions. A Sybil cluster forms a sparse external cut with low conductance; min-cut transitivity bounds limit its stationary mass and aggregate voting weight unless honest attestations cross the cut. A forge of identities, an atlas of aliases, or a gale of fabricated edges cannot bypass this bottleneck without costly cross-cut trust.
